content.short: Tonpay is a fast and secure payment solution platform on TON for personal and business transactions.
content.description: Tonpay is a comprehensive cryptocurrency payment gateway and ecosystem built on the TON blockchain. It enables both individuals and businesses to accept Toncoin and various Jettons securely and efficiently, featuring non-custodial wallet integration and instant settlements. Tonpay provides a range of tools including payment links, invoicing, and e-commerce plugins that simplify the process of blockchain-based commerce. By prioritizing a user-friendly experience and low transaction costs, Tonpay is driving the real-world adoption of digital assets within the global TON community.
content.meta: Accept TON payments easily with Tonpay. Fast and secure crypto payment gateway on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
